in_hebrew.name: מָרִיס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'maras' (bitter), possibly a place name or a personal name derived from a bitter spring or a bitter tree.

in_greek.name: Μαρρίς
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root 'marros' (bitter), possibly a place name referring to a body of water that is bitter or a personal name derived from the bitter emotions experienced by the bearer.

in_latin.name: Marris
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'maris' (sea) and 'aris' (bitter), possibly a personal name for someone who endured bitterness while at sea.
